name: Resmetirom

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hepatotoxicity : Monitor patients during treatment with REZDIFFRA for elevations in liver tests and for the development of liver-related adverse reactions. Discontinue REZDIFFRA and continue to monitor the patient if hepatotoxicity is suspected. (5.1) Gallbladder-Related Adverse Reactions :…

summary: Official drug warnings state that patients taking this medicine should be checked for signs of liver damage, known as hepatotoxicity, as well as gallbladder problems [3]. If liver injury is suspected, the drug should be stopped and the patient must continue to be watched closely [3]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than testing on people estimated a high risk score of 73 for the liver and a low risk score of 31 for the heart [M].
